title: Radiant Retreat | KEY.co
description_expanded: Set among the soaring pines of Tahoe Donner, this newly built mountain retreat blends modern luxury with effortless comfort. Striking design details and colorful, curated finishes fill every corner of this thoughtfully crafted four-bedroom home, where expansive windows bathe the open-concept interiors in natural light. The heart of the home is the stunning kitchen, complete with brand-new cabinetry, sleek stainless steel appliances, and a generous island ideal for gathering. The cozy living area features plush seating, a statement gas fireplace, and a 64” smart TV, perfect for unwinding after a day on the slopes. Every space from the whimsical wallpaper in the hall bath to the heated driveway and EV charger reflects a commitment to style, ease, and modern living. The layout is perfectly suited for families and groups alike, offering multiple levels of privacy and space to recharge. The serene primary suite feels like a private spa, with a standalone soaking tub framed by forest views. Upstairs, two inviting bedrooms and a playful bunk room make it easy for everyone to settle in, while the lower-level suite with its own living area and ensuite bath adds flexibility and comfort. Outdoor living is just as inviting, with a sun-drenched front deck and a tranquil back patio nestled in the trees. Just minutes from world-class ski resorts and downtown Truckee, and with full access to Tahoe Donner’s coveted amenities, this home offers a sophisticated basecamp for year-round mountain adventures.
